localChanges: A city on the first or last column had its name cut in half, and a city on the bottom row had no name at all: the label is drawn centred on the city and wider than the tile, and whatever hung past the edge of the map was thrown away rather than continuing round the other side. It now continues round.

Selecting a unit, or moving one, used to redraw every unit on the map -- over twelve hundred tiles for a single step -- when only two tiles can have changed: the one the unit left and the one it arrived at. City names were being redrawn the same way, wiping the whole layer and searching the entire world for cities on every message from the game. Between them they were the last two places the renderer still did a full-map pass, so nothing does one now.
